    | String name;

    | day

      instruction
        | name = "Other";
  jump
    | return name

== Switches.fallthrough (line 18)
| int fallthrough(int a)
  instruction
    | int r = 0;
  case
    | a
    | 1
    | 2
    | default
    -
      instruction
        | r += 1;
      instruction
        | r += 2;
    -
      instruction
        | r += 2;
    -
      instruction
        | r = -1;
  jump
    | return r
